name: Hachimantai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hachimantai city emblem in blue and green: a disc of blue above with a white mountain outline, and a green mountain above green stripes below.
history: Municipal flag of Hachimantai, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 September 2005.

features.role: Hachimantai city emblem — a disc of blue above with a white mountain outline, and a green mountain above green stripes below
